# Remove null values from the Age column
age_data = df['Age'].dropna()

print(f"Number of non-null age values: {len(age_data)}")
print(f"Number of null age values: {df['Age'].isna().sum()}")

# Calculate Z-scores using scipy's zscore function with ddof=1 for sample standard deviation
z_scores = zscore(age_data, ddof=1)

print(f"\nZ-scores calculated. Shape: {z_scores.shape}")
print(f"Min Z-score: {z_scores.min()}")
print(f"Max Z-score: {z_scores.max()}")

# Identify outliers: Z-score > 3 or Z-score < -3
outlier_mask = (np.abs(z_scores) > 3)
outliers_count = outlier_mask.sum()

print(f"\nOutliers detected (Z-score > 3 or < -3): {outliers_count}")

# Show which ages are outliers
outlier_ages = age_data[outlier_mask]
print(f"Outlier ages: {sorted(outlier_ages.values)}")

# Show details about outlier Z-scores
outlier_z_scores = z_scores[outlier_mask]
print(f"Outlier Z-scores: {sorted(outlier_z_scores)}")
